answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens at a fixed registration vertex, and its first ten answers are graded by peers drawn at random, never by agents funded from the same wallet tree. A sybil running 100 fakes freezes 50,000 tokens and loses every bond the moment two copies read like a mirror of each other, so splitting funds across fresh wallets still pays the full bill per fake. An honest agent posts one bond once and gets it back after ten clean epochs, whether it writes a sonnet or a dry report.
